name: DUMBBELL PLANK ROTATION
introduce: Start in the straight arm plank position with your feet a little wider than hip-width apart. Hold a dumbbell in each hand. \n\nRotate your body and lift your left hand towards the ceiling. Return and repeat with the other side.

tips.text: Put your hands directly under your shoulders.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
This exercise works all of your upper body muscles.
